# `oaap app restart`

recreate an instance's containers (RFC-0038 D4).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app restart [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT] name
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | -- |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |
